::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints"}
#docs
Without `limit`/`starting_after` every endpoint comes back, unpaged. With either, the list is paged (newest first) and carries `has_more`, `next_cursor` and, on the first page, `total`.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of endpoints to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The webhook endpoint's id (whe_…). |
| `data.url` | `string` | The URL that receives the webhooks. |
| `data.business` | `string` | Business scope; null = receives all of the org’s events in this endpoint’s partition. |
| `data.livemode` | `string` | The endpoint's partition. An endpoint only ever receives events from businesses in its own partition; org-level events (no business) reach both. Immutable. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `data.signing_secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation; verify deliveries with HMAC-SHA256. |
| `data.enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the endpoint receives webhooks. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid limit |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "webhook_endpoint",
      "id": "whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
      "url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
      "livemode": "test",
      "enabled": false
    }
  ]
}
```
```json [400 Bad Request]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Invalid limit"
  }
}
```
